questions.question: Which elective principle was first introduced in Nigeria's colonial history under the Clifford Constitution of 1922?

options.A: Universal adult suffrage across all regions
options.B: Indirect election through regional native authorities
options.C: Direct election restricted to Lagos and Calabar
options.D: Proportional representation in the Legislative Council

questions.question: The Richards Constitution of 1946 was structurally significant primarily because it introduced which framework into Nigerian politics?

options.B: Regionalism dividing the country into three units
options.C: Unicameral federal parliament with equal seats
options.D: Complete judicial review by native courts

questions.question: Which constitutional arrangement created a formal quasi-federal structure and established ministerial positions for Nigerians in 1951?

options.A: Established true federalism with autonomous regions
options.B: Abolished the office of the Governor-General
options.C: Unified the civil services of all three regions
options.D: Granted full independence to the Southern Cameroons

questions.question: What key institutional change marked the passage of the 1963 Republican Constitution of Nigeria?

options.A: The Privy Council was retained as the highest court
options.B: The British monarch ceased to be the Head of State
options.C: An executive presidential system was introduced
options.D: The Senate was merged into a single chamber

options.A: National Council of Nigeria and the Cameroons (NCNC)

questions.question: What primary function distinguishes a political party from a pressure group or interest group?

options.B: Mobilizing public opinion on single issues
options.C: Contesting elections to capture state power

questions.question: A major criticism often leveled against proportional representation (PR) electoral systems is that they:

options.A: Frequently result in unstable coalition governments
options.B: Waste a vast majority of cast votes

options.B: Guaranteeing free, fair, and impartial elections
options.C: Funding campaign activities of ruling parties
